description: This file defines an Android Activity class ReceiveShare that handles shared data received via intent, processes the data to display information, and can invoke a service to handle the shared content.

classes.name: ReceiveShare
classes.description: An Android activity that handles shared content sent to the app, displays shared information, and can start a service for further processing.

methods.name: getShareUri
methods.description: Extracts the shared URI from the intent, checking both parcelable extra and clip data.

methods.name: buildShareInfo
methods.description: Builds a string containing information about the shared content, including type, text, HTML, and URI details, attempting to access asset file descriptors when possible.
